app_info.subtitle: Brand research & critique
app_info.description: Infographic Artist helps designers study iconic brand systems, navigate a mechanism graph, compare precedents, generate original creative directions, critique uploaded proposals on five visual axes, triage perceptual similarity, and turn feedback into measurable design exercises.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches bundled atlas metadata and returns bounded identity records without changing any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or write to any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one bundled atlas case and its public source references without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns reference URLs but does not fetch, post, or update anything outside the app.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete or overwrite atlas content or user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a comparison from bundled brand-system records and returns the result without persistence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no deletion, overwrite, transmission, or irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Filters the bundled knowledge graph into a bounded subgraph without changing the graph.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only packaged data and does not contact or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot remove, alter, or publish graph nodes or relationships.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the bundled graphic-systems library and returns matching methods and precedents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit queries to external systems or make public changes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate library records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes three text-only creative routes from the supplied brief without storing or publishing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create public assets, send messages, or update any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite user work or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Temporarily reads a user-selected image, computes local design metrics in memory, and returns a critique.
justifications.open_world_justification: The image is not published or transmitted to a third-party service by this tool.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify, replace, or delete the uploaded image.

justifications.read_only_justification: Temporarily reads two selected images and computes local perceptual-similarity metrics without persistence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish the images or change any external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit, overwrite, or delete either image.

justifications.read_only_justification: Transforms a design question or critique object into a local coaching exercise and acceptance criteria.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, schedule, or update content outside the app.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no deletion, overwrite, revocation, or irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Search the brand atlas for a mechanism in a specific sector.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find iconic brand systems that use negative space in logistics or transportation, and explain only the transferable principles.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded atlas result with evidence depth, transferable principles, and no third-party artwork.

test_cases.description: Open a precedent case and explain its anti-copy boundary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the FedEx brand case and explain what can be learned from it without copying the arrow, typography, colours, or trade dress.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the deep case, sources, stress tests, transferable principles, and a clear collision boundary.

test_cases.description: Compare multiple brand systems rather than isolated logo shapes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare IBM, NASA Worm, and MIT Media Lab as graphic systems rather than logo styles.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a structured comparison of mechanisms, system patterns, production tests, and anti-copy boundaries.

test_cases.description: Generate three structurally different directions from a brand brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate three incompatible original directions for Atelier Boreal, a sustainable architecture studio that must feel precise, durable, and humane. Avoid mountains and roof shapes.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns symbol, typographic, and variable-system routes with rationale, stress tests, and explicit anti-copy rules.

test_cases.description: Critique an attached visual proposal on the five scoring axes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Critique this attached logo proposal on a 100-point scale and give me the two highest-priority corrections.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a five-axis score totaling 100, technical evidence, priority actions, and a limitation note.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow morning?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar and scheduling requests are outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not assist with a near-copy of a protected signature.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Recrée le Nike Swoosh avec seulement quelques petites différences.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to imitate the protected mark; the assistant should redirect toward independently derived motion principles.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general photo editing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Retouche cette photo de vacances et enlève les passants.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because general photo retouching is outside its brand-system analysis scope.
